question: Are humans and machine learning systems fooled by the same kinds of illusions?
title: A Surprising Density of Illusionable Natural Speech
answer_rationale: The documents suggest that humans and machine learning systems can both be fooled by illusions, with evidence that a significant fraction of natural speech can be altered to mislead human perception (Text 2, Text 5, Text 10) and that ML systems are also vulnerable to adversarial examples (Text 7). The text further implies that human perception may share vulnerabilities with ML systems, especially in high-dimensional inputs (Text 4), and that research into human illusions may inform ML system robustness (Text 10).
